findings.summary: Nothing on the page says which tracks are low-risk. The safe options are hidden behind unfamiliar names and English letters.
Small grey text on a dark background, especially the column headings, is hard to read even when enlarged.
Every row repeats the same labels (shares/foreign currency, savings/deposit, 3/5 years), so the reader has to re-read them.
The ring charts use two similar colours, and the reader has to look back and forth to match them with the numbers beside them.
Many rows show 'less than 3 years' instead of a return, so the safer bond tracks can't be compared.
High stock returns (24%, 26%) draw the eye, but the risk behind them isn't explained.
Some marks are unclear: 'not yet reported' with an orange icon, and a 101% share in stocks.
The reader doesn't know the site 'מקור' or who runs it.
